claims.claim: A child can qualify for Child Disability Payment because of a physical or mental disability.
claims.quote: You can apply for children under 16 with a physical or mental disability.
claims.note: The source expressly names physical and mental disabilities.

claims.claim: For the care component, a child under 16 must need substantially more care or supervision than a child of the same age.
claims.quote: The individual’s need for attention or supervision either: must be substantially more than would be expected for a person of the same age
claims.note: The source states the same-age comparison for under-16 care needs.

claims.claim: A child may qualify for the mobility component because of difficulty walking.
claims.quote: Higher This is a weekly rate of £80. It's for a child who is 3 or older and either: unable to walk unable to walk outdoors whose health would get worse from walking
claims.note: The source gives walking difficulty as a mobility route.
